title: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury
summary: Published 2012 KDIGO AKI guideline. Official 2026 page says a first major update is in public-review draft; the draft is not yet a published replacement. Current/supersession therefore requires release-time adjudication and must not be assumed.
superseded_by: KDIGO 2026 AKI/AKD public-review draft pending publication; release-time adjudication required

title: KDIGO 2026 Clinical Practice Guideline for Acute Kidney Injury and Acute Kidney Disease - Public Review Draft
summary: Official public-review draft; not a final published guideline and not eligible for current formal guideline claims.

title: UK Kidney Association Clinical Practice Guideline: Treatment of Acute Hyperkalaemia in Adults
summary: Final October 2023 guideline; official page gives review date October 2026 and includes emergency thresholds and pseudo-hyperkalaemia specimen guidance.

title: Consensus recommendations on the diagnosis and treatment of hyponatremia from the Austrian Society for Nephrology 2024
summary: Current society consensus on sodium classification, symptoms, osmolality and pseudohyponatremia.

title: Guidelines on the management of abnormal liver blood tests
summary: British Society of Gastroenterology guideline on initial analytes, context and common biochemical patterns.

title: 2023 ESC Guidelines for the management of acute coronary syndromes
summary: Official ESC current guideline landing page. Local copy records title/version/authority only; ESC page states formal licensing is required for guideline content included in AI systems, so no guideline-body quote is stored here.
